_notes: The claim/span gold's composition frame, RATIFIED BY THE OWNER 2026-08-17 before any pair was authored. Ratified alongside SPAN_LABELLING.md, which was also written before any pair existed (rule-then-pairs). This file is the authoring contract: an author fills its slots and may not move a count. Every number below is derived in the `derivations` block rather than chosen, on T2.124's precedent that a frame with free parameters lets a score-aware party pick the one that flatters.

derivations.total_260: 200 is doc 17 §6's floor per task variant. 30% headroom above it absorbs retirements without forcing a re-harvest, which is what T2.124's late retire-and-replace round cost when it had none.
derivations.entailed_120: The recall bar is 0.90 and its lattice is k/gold_entailed, so 0.90 must land exactly or the bar silently becomes stricter than stated — T2.115's whole round was that defect on the claim/fact gold. 0.90 × 120 = 108 exactly, tolerating 12 misses. 100, 110 and 130 are also exact; 120 was taken for headroom over the floor at a pair count the pool supports.
derivations.precision_bar_not_sized: 0.95 on entailed precision CANNOT be sized by a frame: its denominator is tp+fp, which depends on the judge's false accepts. Stated here so nobody later reads the census as guaranteeing both bars are on-lattice.
derivations.near_misses_145: span-truncation 30 + context-dependence 30 + overreach 30 + value-swap 25 + structure-fragment 30 = 145 of 260 = 56%, satisfying doc 17 §6's 'near-misses the majority'. `unrelated` (10) is the only easy negative and is deliberately the smallest slice: an easy negative measures nothing about the boundary.
derivations.span_specific_120: The four slices this gold exists for carry 120 of 260 — the largest single group. A claim/span gold whose bulk was transferable slices would measure what the claim/fact gold already measures.
derivations.block_supply: 260 pairs, of which 30 multi-span consume ≥2 blocks → ~290 block-slots. Cap of 2 pairs per block (T2.124's correlated-evidence finding: four pairs of one construction on one premise is 'correlated evidence wearing four rows') → ≥145 distinct blocks needed against 800 harvested.
derivations.prose_supply: The prose-hungry slices (truncation, context-dependence, paraphrase, weakening, overreach, value-swap) total 165 pairs. Against the 67 paragraphs ≥80 chars alone that is 2.5 per block, ABOVE the cap — so list items ≥40 chars (375) are in the prose pool too, giving 442 blocks and 0.37 pairs per block. Recorded because the paragraph-only reading would have made the frame infeasible and it is not obvious.

authoring_rules.anchors_are_computed: Every anchor is produced by span_pair_builder.PairBuilder; a hand-typed char_span or text_sha256 is a defect. The builder refuses a quote absent from the named block, a quote occurring more than once, and any anchor that fails to round-trip through the real loader.
authoring_rules.rationale_cites_a_named_rule: Free-text rationales are refused at adjudication; cite a rule by its name in SPAN_LABELLING.md.
